contributions.name: Spur IP Context
contributions.description: Enrich IP addresses with Spur's VPN, residential proxy, and anonymization context
contributions.instructions: Each lookup sends the queried public IP to Spur and consumes a query from the user's Spur subscription; look up only IPs relevant to the task and do not repeat lookups. Treat VPN, proxy, and tunnel labels as anonymity context, not malicious reputation or attribution. Never block or accuse solely from this classification.
